evd_title: LLM confidence approaches zero across 498 model-instance SPOT evaluations with only 2 full-confidence cases
finding: LLM confidence approaches zero across 498 model-instance SPOT evaluations with only 2 full-confidence cases
P: SPOT benchmark: 83 STEM manuscripts, 91 author-confirmed errors (47 source papers, 10 domains); 83 x 6 = 498 model-instance evaluations
I: 6 proprietary multimodal LLMs (o3, GPT-4.1, Gemini-2.5-Pro, Gemini-2.0-Flash-Lite, Claude-3.7-Sonnet +/-Thinking); zero-shot, text+images, 8 runs
C: Other models; perfect-calibration diagonal vs pass@4
O: Run-frequency confidence: full confidence (detected in 8/8 runs) in 2 of 498 evaluations, both o3; KDE peaks near 0
T: Post-2024 WithdrarXiv/PubPeer papers; models o3 2025-04-16, GPT-4.1 2025-04-14 etc. (paper 2025)
